albums.title: Validly
albums.summary: Copyright-registered certificate platform, delivered with Extreme Programming and accepted via a client-signed UAT.
albums.description: Validly is a multi-tenant platform for certificate generation with QR verification, built as my undergraduate thesis for CV. Oemah Website Purwokerto. We worked with Extreme Programming in close collaboration with the client, negotiating requirements continuously, and the result was accepted through a User Acceptance Test signed off by the client. The computer program is officially registered as copyright (Reg. No. 001273151, June 2026).

albums.title: 7th Dies Natalis of Software Engineering
albums.summary: Organized the 7th anniversary events for the Software Engineering program, featuring competitions, a traditional ceremony, and a national seminar.
albums.description: Served as the Event Division Staff (Staff Divisi Acara) for the 7th Dies Natalis (Anniversary) of the Software Engineering study program in 2023. The celebration featured a series of events, starting with 'Tumpengan' (a traditional thanksgiving ceremony) and PELOSE (Pekan Lomba SE), which included various inter-class and inter-batch competitions. The event series concluded with a National Seminar. I was responsible for coordinating the event flow, ensuring all activities ran smoothly from the competitions to the final seminar.

albums.description: Upon joining HMSE (Himpunan Mahasiswa Software Engineering) at Telkom University as an Intern Staff, I was specifically assigned to the External and Social Department. I facilitated inter-association relations as a Master of Ceremony, organized comparative studies with other universities like IT Telkom Surabaya, managed Ramadan social service programs in collaboration with Dompet Dhuafa, and coordinated collaborative dialogue sessions with student executive boards.

albums.title: Organizing Committee Chair - SEIRAMA
albums.summary: Led the organizing committee for SEIRAMA 2024, an Iftar gathering connecting Software Engineering students, lecturers, and an orphanage.
albums.description: Served as the Organizing Committee Chair (Ketua Pelaksana) for SEIRAMA (Software Engineering Berbuka Bersama) in 2024. This community event brought together Software Engineering students, faculty members, and children from the Harapan Mulia Orphanage for a meaningful Iftar gathering. My responsibilities included leading the committee, coordinating event logistics, delivering the opening speech, and ensuring the smooth execution of the program, which also featured a religious sermon (kultum) by Ustadz Kharisma Panji Krisna, S.T.

albums.title: Organizing Committee Chair - SELP 3.0
albums.summary: Led the organizing committee for the Software Engineering Leadership Project 3.0, facilitating a leadership and bonding camp for the 2023 freshman class.
albums.description: Served as the Organizing Committee Chair (Ketua Pelaksana) for the Software Engineering Leadership Project 3.0, specifically overseeing the Basic Leadership Training (LDK) and Familiarity Night (Makrab) for the 2023 freshman batch. Held at Villa Laris Baturraden, the event was designed to foster leadership skills, teamwork, and strong internal bonds among the new students. My responsibilities included managing the entire event committee, directing the execution timeline from planning to completion, delivering the opening remarks, and coordinating closely with university stakeholders, including the Head of the Study Program representatives.

albums.title: Staff of Member Empowerment (PEMDA)
albums.summary: Focused on internal capacity building, member evaluation, and fostering a cohesive organizational culture within HMSE.
albums.description: Transitioning from an intern role, I officially became a Staff member of the Member Empowerment (PEMDA) Department at HMSE. My primary responsibility was to oversee internal capacity building and maintain a strong, cohesive environment for all members. This involved monitoring member performance, facilitating internal bonding events, and representing the association in comparative studies with other universities to exchange organizational best practices. At the end of the term, I also took part in presenting our department's work results and performance metrics during the official accountability session.

albums.title: Teaching Assistant - Operating Systems
albums.summary: Guided over 140 students through 13 modules on operating system fundamentals and advanced Linux operations at the Informatics Laboratory.
albums.description: Served as a Teaching Assistant (Asisten Praktikum) for the Operating Systems course at the Informatics Laboratory (Programming Lab) of Telkom University Purwokerto. I facilitated hands-on practical sessions for over 140 students, guiding them through 13 comprehensive modules. The curriculum deeply covered operating system fundamentals, process scheduling, memory management, and advanced Linux terminal operations. My responsibilities included delivering technical demonstrations on the command-line interface, assisting students with hands-on system exercises, and evaluating their practical understanding of OS environments.

albums.title: Teaching Assistant - Web Design & Programming
albums.summary: Guided students through 12 foundational and framework modules in web development, concluding with comprehensive final project evaluations.
albums.description: Selected as a Teaching Assistant (Asisten Praktikum) for the Web Design and Programming course at the Informatics Laboratory of Telkom University Purwokerto. I facilitated hands-on practical sessions, guiding students through 12 comprehensive modules covering foundational web programming concepts and framework-based development utilizing Laravel. My responsibilities included delivering technical material, assisting students with code debugging from the TA desk, and conducting thorough evaluations of their final projects (Tugas Besar) to ensure a solid grasp of web application architecture.

albums.title: Vocational Intern - Diskominfo South Kalimantan
albums.summary: Completed a 3-month vocational field internship (PKL) at the Department of Communication and Informatics of South Kalimantan Province.
albums.description: As part of my vocational high school (SMK) curriculum, I completed a 3-month field internship (Praktek Kerja Lapangan / PKL) at the Department of Communication and Informatics (Diskominfo) of South Kalimantan Province. Running from January 6 to March 31, 2021, this internship provided foundational exposure to government IT infrastructure and services, equipping me with early professional experience in technology administration and support within the public sector.

albums.title: Web Developer Intern & Team Lead
albums.summary: Led the web development team during a university-mandated internship at Oemah Website, concluding with an 'Excellent' (Amat Baik) evaluation.
albums.description: Completed a university-mandated internship (Kerja Praktik) at CV Oemah Website Teknologi (Oemah Website Purwokerto) serving as the Web Developer Team Lead. I directed the development team in engineering a provincial government IT infrastructure security audit system for Diskominfo, utilizing Laravel and role-based access control. The program commenced with a comprehensive onboarding session led directly by the CEO, Mr. Agus Darmawan. At the end of the term, I successfully completed the program and received an 'Excellent' (Amat Baik) performance evaluation.
